step.title: Greedy wrap(text, width) with tests
step.doneWhen: wrap() breaks lines at the last space that fits; node --test passes

decisions: D1: greedy line breaking over optimal — because it is what fmt/fold do and the simplest thing that works
constraints: C1: no runtime dependencies — because the demo must run anywhere Node runs
C2: node:test only — because the point is the loop, not the test framework
